title: Related projects are not automatically one release
when: A second related project appears or a change spans repositories
need: Keep one item per project with linked companion work. Identify whether the relationship is dependency only or whether one actual build ships both sources; matching names or a general relationship grants no completion authority.
surface: JOURNEYS row 14; delivery binding rules and public item-bound delivery.
gap: Runtime supports bound sources, but a short guided linking/adoption home is still needed. Do not auto-create shared deployment bindings for every related project.
